simple.meaning: קָלָה (qâlâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be light (as implied in rapid motion), but figuratively, only ( be [causatively, hold ] in contempt ).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 6 times across Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, Proverbs, Isaiah, beginning at Deuteronomy 25:3. Its contexts include family, family line, Torah, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָלָה (H7034).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קָלָה (qâlâh) / H7034 is traced through Deuteronomy 25:3, Deuteronomy 27:16, 1 Samuel 18:23, Proverbs 12:9 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.

timeline.evidenceText: He may sentence him to no more than forty stripes. He shall not give more, lest if he should give more and beat him more than that many stripes, then your brother will be degraded in your sight.
‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’
Saul’s servants spoke those words in the ears of David. David said, “Does it seem to you a light thing to be the king’s son-in-law, since I am a poor man, and little known?”
Better is he who is little known, and has a servant,

But now Yahweh has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”

definitions.full: H7034. qalah II. [ קָלָה ] verb Niph`al belightly esteemed, dishonoured (|| form of קלל ; compare Late Hebrew קְלנָא ᵑ7 קָלוֺן, disgrace, shame) ; — Perfect 3masculine singular consecutive וְנִקְלָה Isa 16:14 ; Deut 25:3 ; Participle נִקְלֶה Isa 3:5 2 t.; — be lightly esteemed , held of little account, 16:14 (glory of Moab); וְנִקְלֶה רָשׁ אִישׁ 1Sam 18:23 ; so ( Participle as substantive) Isa 3:5 (opposed to נִכְבָּד ), Prov 12:9 (opposed to מִתְכַּבֵּד ); more positively, be dishonoured , degraded, Deut 25:3 ( עֵינֶיךָ ). Hiph`il treat with contempt, dishonour, Participle וגו אָבִיו ׳מַקְלֶה Deut 27:16 one dis-honouring [i.e. opposed to כַּבֵּד of 5th Command].
